children.text: Anna Kovalchuk plays the character Maria Shvetsova in the Russian television series "Tainy Sledstviya" (Secrets of Investigation). The series follows the work of Chief Detective Maria Shvetsova in the St. Petersburg District IC Investigative Committee of Russia. This character role is the likely subject of the prize Anna Leonidovna Kovalchuk won at the legal festival "Law and Society." Source: d0.

No relevant facts found in provided sources (d1, d4, d7). The documents discuss the Glanville Davies affair, John Ballem, and general legal history, but contain no mention of Anna Leonidovna Kovalchuk, the "Law and Society" legal festival, or any character name associated with a prize she won.

Anna Leonidovna Kovalchuk won a prize at the international legal festival "Law and Society" for the presentation of the image of a "good character." The prize was awarded for her title role in the television series "Tainy Sledstviya" (Secrets of Investigation). Therefore, the character's name is the title role in "Tainy Sledstviya." Source: d8.
